description: HMAC-signed proof that vendor access and rights were ready before the registered deadline, plus short-lived action-specific permits for authenticated capture.

receipt_rules.deadline: Issue only while the Phase 6 activation packet is READY_FOR_ACTIVATION and authorized_at is at or before access_ready_by.
receipt_rules.rights: Hash the approved rights attestation bytes and store only credential presence, never credential material.
receipt_rules.signature: Sign the canonical receipt with HMAC-SHA256 under MACRO_LAB_AUTHORIZATION_KEY; the key is environment-only and at least 32 characters.
receipt_rules.roster: Bind the exact roster SHA-256, source event, official schedule receipt and activation-packet hash.
receipt_rules.validity: A valid receipt survives the access-ready deadline but expires after the registered stream tail.

permit_rules.binding_snapshot: May be issued after access authorization and before release to resolve provider event IDs.
permit_rules.pre_release_snapshot: May be issued only inside the registered maximum pre-release snapshot age.
permit_rules.calendar_stream: May be issued only inside the registered stream lead and remains valid through the registered stream tail.
permit_rules.enforcement: Authenticated snapshot and stream capture functions must validate the action, signature and current time before network or payload processing.
permit_rules.scope: Permits authorize capture only and never authorize price joining, model fitting or orders.
